# Slice In

**Motion › Split** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (14–60)

The new scene arrives in vertical slices that slide up into place one after another.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/slice-in@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Title sequences
- Fashion and editorial
- Energetic section changes

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import sliceIn from './transitions/05-motion/split/slice-in';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(sliceIn, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slices` | integer | `5` | 2–16 | Number of slices. |
| `stagger` | number | `0.45` | 0–0.8 | How much the slices arrive one after another. |
| `from` | enum | `"bottom"` | `bottom` · `top` · `alternate` | Where the slices come from. |
